description: meta ads must haves: episode 5 🎬 targeting is where most beginners get overwhelmed… so let's simplify it. there are four targeting options inside meta and knowing when to use each one is what separates a strategic media buyer from someone just guessing. here's the breakdown 👇 🎯 interest targeting this is where most people start. you're telling meta who to target based on their interests, behaviors, and demographics. great for cold audiences when you don't have much data yet. think beyond the obvious, go deeper than just the product category and think about who that person is holistically. 🔄 retargeting these are the people who already know your brand. website visitors, cart abandoners, video viewers, instagram engagers. they've shown interest but haven't converted yet. these audiences are your highest converting and lowest cost per purchase because the hard work of building awareness is already done. 👯 lookalike audiences meta takes your best existing customers and finds new people who look and behave just like them. the better your source audience the better your lookalike. great for scaling what's already working. 🌐 broad targeting little to no targeting parameters, you're letting meta's AI do the work. and honestly? this is where the platform is heading. meta's algorithm has gotten so good that broad targeting is outperforming heavily defined audiences more and more often. so when in doubt, go broad. trust the AI. let your creative do the targeting work and let meta find the right person. the best media buyers aren't the ones who over-engineer their audiences. they're the ones who know when to get out of the algorithm's way. follow for more content like this👆 #metaads #facebookads #instagramads #mediabuyerlife #freelancemediabuyer
